correctness.rationale: The market has 5 possible ordered couple-option lists, 2^2 single preference configurations and 24^2 hospital priority pairs: exactly 11520 labeled profiles. At capacity (1,1), stable couple-assigned outcomes require a dominant option; if the couple stays out, both singles must fill one hospital each and neither singleton nor listed couple may block. This yields an exact criterion. Read both independent source verifiers; independently enumerated every feasible couple state and all 3^2 single assignments under capacities (1,1),(2,1),(1,2), respecting separate S1/S2 blocking. Recovered nonexistence by option list [0,128,128,192,192], total 640, and zero instances that failed either individual one-seat repair. This is a complete finite proof under this BIS definition, not extrapolation to larger markets or S3 same-hospital deviations.
